content:
Trumpty Dumpty wants the USA to leave NATO. 

There’s just a small wrinkle in his plan:

NATO Withdrawal Act (Section 1250A of the NDAA): Enacted in late 2023, this law explicitly prohibits any President from withdrawing the U.S. from NATO without either:  
• 2/3 approval from the Senate (67 votes).
• An Act of Congress (legislation passed by both the House and Senate).

Plus, the US has to give NATO one year notice (Article 15, North Atlantic Treaty).

Sorry for the bad news, MAGA.
